projects.projectName: Premera Blue Cross - Producer Portal Development - Phase 1

riskDescription.context: The project has absorbed approximately 14 scope changes equivalent to 0.75–1 sprint of additional effort, and EMS Risk R857 (Scope changes) remains Identified with mitigation status Assessed as of 29-Jun-2026.
riskDescription.condition: Further scope additions may exceed the remaining buffer and delay delivery timelines beyond the 25-Aug-2026 Production Deploy target.
riskDescription.consequence: Timeline slippage could impact client go-live plans, erode margin due to unplanned effort, and weaken stakeholder confidence in delivery predictability.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Establish formal change control procedure requiring impact assessment and client approval before accepting any new scope additions.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Upon acceptance of scope changes exceeding one sprint effort, rebaseline delivery plan with client and defer non-critical features to post-Production.
risks.reasoning: Open EMS risk R857 with Identified status and no finalized mitigation; WSR documents additional BoB scope change (#17) agreed in-scope with DH impact analysis still pending. Mitigation needs to be arrived per EMS.

riskDescription.context: Integration testing requires upstream system support for test data setup to validate integration and E2E scenarios, raised 30-Jun-2026 in WSR and agreed by Premera to address, but no resolution date is documented.
riskDescription.condition: Delayed upstream system support may prevent completion of E2E test scenarios before UAT Signoff on 14-Aug-2026.
riskDescription.consequence: Incomplete E2E validation could allow integration defects to surface during UAT or Production, delaying signoff and increasing rework cost.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Conduct weekly status reviews with Premera upstream teams to track test data readiness and escalate blockers by 01-Aug-2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should upstream data setup delay beyond 08-Aug-2026, initiate parallel E2E testing with synthetic data and escalate to project steering committee.
risks.reasoning: Single-source signal from WSR 22-Jul-2026; dependency on external Premera upstream teams with no documented ETA; UAT Signoff is 23 days from WSR date.

riskDescription.context: Data availability on Dev/ACPT environments for related Data Hub entities (BoB) remains open per WSR 22-Jul-2026, and data mappings are mostly closed but possible values are still being discussed.
riskDescription.condition: Incomplete or inconsistent test data may prevent thorough functional and integration testing before UAT.
riskDescription.consequence: Data-related defects could emerge late in UAT, requiring rework and potentially delaying Production Deploy on 25-Aug-2026.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Validate current data mappings with Data Hub team by 29-Jul-2026 and document all open possible values for UAT verification.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once data defects are identified in UAT, activate dedicated data remediation team and communicate revised signoff date to stakeholders within 24 hours.
risks.reasoning: Single-source signal from WSR 22-Jul-2026; WSR advises to proceed with current mapping definitions and handle E2E/UAT issues later, indicating accepted risk with no mitigation plan.

riskDescription.context: Citrix slowness and frequent disconnection are impacting delivery per EMS go-green plan as of 29-Jun-2026, and a ticket to address the issue with Premera IT is planned but not yet raised.
riskDescription.condition: Continued VDI connectivity disruptions may reduce productive development and testing hours during the Build + SIT stage.
riskDescription.consequence: Loss of productive hours could compress sprint capacity, delay feature completion, and increase pressure on the UAT timeline.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Raise priority ticket with Premera IT by 26-Jul-2026 and monitor VDI performance daily with escalation threshold of three disruptions per week.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: When VDI disruptions exceed three incidents per week, request alternate remote access solution and extend sprint timeline by two days with client approval.
risks.reasoning: Confirmed in EMS go-green plan 29-Jun-2026; mitigation (ticket to Premera IT) planned but not yet executed; similar VDI disruption noted in related AI Platform Build project on same client infrastructure.

riskDescription.context: Pipelines require reconfiguration and base images rebuild after repository fork per WSR 22-Jul-2026, with no documented completion date or owner assignment.
riskDescription.condition: Delayed pipeline reconfiguration may block automated build and deployment workflows during the Build + SIT stage.
riskDescription.consequence: Manual workarounds could slow down sprint velocity, increase deployment errors, and delay readiness for UAT.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Assign DevOps resource to complete pipeline reconfiguration and base image rebuild by 02-Aug-2026 with daily progress tracking.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: If pipeline reconfiguration extends beyond 02-Aug-2026, implement manual build and deployment checklist and communicate two-day buffer extension to UAT team.
risks.reasoning: Single-source signal from WSR 22-Jul-2026; no documented owner or ETA; pipeline stability is critical for continuous integration in Build + SIT stage.

riskDescription.context: Dashboard requirement (#29) raised 15-Jun-2026 requires data to be shown for all role types, with Premera as owner, but no resolution or delivery date is documented in WSR 22-Jul-2026.
riskDescription.condition: Unresolved dashboard requirement may remain incomplete at UAT entry, requiring late-stage rework or deferral.
riskDescription.consequence: Late clarification or scope addition could delay UAT Signoff on 14-Aug-2026 or force a production workaround, impacting user experience.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Escalate dashboard requirement (#29) to Premera business owner by 25-Jul-2026 and secure final clarification before UAT entry on 05-Aug-2026.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Should requirement remain unresolved by 05-Aug-2026, document as known limitation in UAT scope and schedule post-Production enhancement with client agreement.
risks.reasoning: Single-source signal from WSR 22-Jul-2026; requirement raised over one month prior with no documented progress; owner is client (Premera), introducing dependency risk.

riskDescription.context: WSR 22-Jul-2026 advises to proceed with current data mapping definitions and handle issues during E2E/UAT later, while possible values for data are still being discussed.
riskDescription.condition: Deferred data mapping validation may result in a cluster of data-related defects surfacing during UAT.
riskDescription.consequence: High defect volume in UAT could overwhelm the team, delay signoff on 14-Aug-2026, and compress the Production Deploy window.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Schedule detailed QE review with Data Hub team by 29-Jul-2026 to validate all data mappings before UAT entry.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Once data defects exceed ten critical issues in UAT, activate defect triage war room and negotiate three-day UAT extension with client stakeholders.
risks.reasoning: Single-source signal from WSR 22-Jul-2026; explicit acceptance of deferred validation risk with no documented mitigation; UAT is 23 days from WSR date.

riskDescription.context: EMS go-green plan as of 29-Jun-2026 requires updating retry logic to classify invalid email-format failures as non-retryable, deploying to Production, re-enabling Azure 4xx/5xx alerts, and continuing Hypercare monitoring.
riskDescription.condition: Incomplete or delayed execution of the go-green plan may leave false-positive P4 incidents unresolved, masking valid production failures post-deployment.
riskDescription.consequence: Undetected production issues could degrade user experience, delay incident response, and erode client trust during Hypercare.

risks.mitigationPreventiveAction: Deploy retry logic update to Production by 20-Aug-2026 and re-enable Azure 4xx/5xx alerts with validation in pre-Production environment.
risks.contingencyCorrectiveAction: Monitor alert false-positive rate daily post-deployment and revert to manual incident triage if false positives exceed five per day.
risks.reasoning: Confirmed in EMS go-green plan 29-Jun-2026; plan is documented and actionable; likelihood is low given clear mitigation steps, but impact remains medium if not executed before Production Deploy on 25-Aug-2026.
